[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
James was born about 1802. He was the son of [[Glasgow-2873|Hugh Glasgow]] and [[Ramsey-9171|Maria Ramsey]]. He passed away in 1872.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2873]] is assessed at 78% (probable). Hugh Glasgow’s held family reconstruction names James Ramsay Glasgow, with Find a Grave and the U.S.House biography as sources for the 1769–1818 congressman. James’s 1802 birth fits Hugh, while the child profile assigns Maria before her reported 1804 marriage.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.
